title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The final work value must be correctly calculated and presented.

title: Process Explanation
description: Important Criteria: The explanation of the four processes in the Carnot cycle must be clear and accurate.

title: Diagrams Inclusion
description: Important Criteria: Both the pressure-volume and enthalpy-entropy diagrams must be included and correctly labeled.

title: Efficiency Formula
description: Important Criteria: The refrigeration efficiency formula must be correctly stated and applied in the calculations.

title: Latent Heat Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The calculation of the latent heat for freezing water must be accurate.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: All units used in calculations must be consistent and correctly applied.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Any sign mistakes or incorrect application of the Carnot cycle principles will lead to deductions.

title: Assumptions Clarification
description: Optional Criteria: Any assumptions made during the calculations should be clearly stated.
